suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects Kotlin Gradle plugin build-cache metadata processing, not kotlin-stdlib runtime code. The NVD generic Kotlin CPE causes this runtime false positive. Mnemos disables Kotlin task build caching until a stable fixed Kotlin release is available. Remove this suppression after upgrading Kotlin.
